title: 1566-1568 Franklin Avenue (Houses), Columbus, Franklin County, OH
notes: Significance: This two family residence is a contributing building in the Columbus Near East Side Historic District, a predominately residential area which developed primarily between 1880 and 1930 and which contains those styles favored by the upper middle class during that period. 1566 Franklin Avenue is located in the eastern portion of the district south of Franklin Park.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 78002063
